notes.title: Happy Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433546/017b58a4542a30039740b753dd2ee263061e3b9e.jpg[/img]

Steam Next Fest begins in just a few hours.
We are super exited that Wild Growth is part of that.
Still happy to take feedback in the steam forums.

Here's a small update that fixes some issues.

Change log 0.1.1:
  - Made Multi Heal Radius slightly smaller.
  - Fixed error in Mana Crystals and their tooltip.
  - Fixed bug where you could select level 8, which doesn't exist.
  - Added an OpenGL launch option that might help you if the game doesn't work on the default setting.

Hope you'll have a nice fest everyone!
/Hannes & Alfred

notes.title: The Demo is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433546/b9393d990aee75f0f7b08fe0d91a067bd5d6dbd5.png[/img]

[h1]The demo for Wild Growth is now live![/h1]

Huge thanks to all of you who played during the play test and left invaluable feedback!
Keep it coming, we are listening! [i](Although, a bit overwhelmed, so responses might be a bit delayed :) )[/i]

We are quite excited about the games reception so far.

Save files from the play test should transfer over to the Demo build.
Leaderboards do not transfer over tho, so now is your chance to snag that top spot!

[b]Changes since playtest:[/b]
	- Added a level 7.
	- A new Overheal mechanic is now unlockable in the tree.
	- Rebalanced mana usage and upgrades. Should now play a larger role throughout the demo.

[b]Known issues:[/b]
	- On older hardware the game might not launch. We are looking into it! 

[b]Make sure you wishlist the game! Thanks again![/b]

Let's keep 'em alive folks! :)
/Hannes & Alfred

notes.title: Change log 0.0.6 (w/ steam deck instructions)
notes.content:
Hey again fam!

Here's another update.
Thanks again for all the feedback. We read everything but due to the volume of feedback, we might not be able to answer in depth to everyone!

Change log 0.0.6:
	- Fixed issue where maximizing a window instantly restored it to non maximized.
	- Renamed some upgrades.
	- Shooting enemies now slow down significantly while they are shooting.
	- Updated to Godot 4.4-beta3

Steam deck:
	- The game can run on steam deck!
	- Go to Properties > Compatibility for the game and enable "Force use of specific Steam Play compatibility tool" and set it to Proton Hotfix. 
	- You can also setup the controls in steam to use the "Mouse Only" template if you don't use an external mouse.
	- This should work out of the box in future versions.

Known issues:
	- It seems the game has trouble launching on some older hardware. Could be related to Vulkan or DX12 compatibility in GPUs. Investigating.

/Hannes & Alfred

notes.title: New Patch 0.0.5
notes.content:
Heyo!

Thanks again for all the fantastic feedback!

Here's a new lil' patch for y'all.

Change log 0.0.5:
- Bosses are more aggressive. Less just floating about.
- Reduced Mana Crystal Increase upgrade to +5mp (down from +10mp)
- Fixed issue where health on players and enemies didn't fill all the way up.
- Improved cast bar readability and juice
- Character Tooltips in warband
- Multi-Heal circle is back
- Results screen now shows gained currencies
- Raised limit of leaderboard entries to 9999
- New logo and title screen
- Updated leaderboard screen

/Hannes & Alfred

notes.title: Bugfix Patch 0.0.4
notes.content:
Hey fam!

Absolutely blown away by the feedback so far. 
Thank you so much. You are awesome!

To celebrate, here's a new build with a couple of fixes to issues you reported.

Changelog:
	✔ Quick Heal now triggers instantly on the second click, but costs 3X the mana.
	✔ Team is now perfectly centered on screen.
	✔ Enemies and bosses no longer spawn super close to the team.
	✔ Multi heal cast time now matches tooltip.
	✔ Multi heal can no longer be cast without targets.
	✔ Pickups no longer slide off screen.
	✔ Fix issue where Heal was getting stuck when target died JUST before the cast landed. Potentially a _frame perfect_ bug :).
	✔ Fix issue where you could click through the tab bar onto the upgrades.
	✔ Enabled HiDPI support - should solve issues on 4k monitors.

Known issues:
	- Latest(ish) nvidia drivers cause garbled graphics on some systems. Nothing I can do right now, but keeping track of it.

/Hannes

notes.title: Playtest 3 is now live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433546/95d683a730651b37718ef4d1d40e5868e1c57ff3.png[/img]
Hiya folks, thank you so much for playing and leaving awesome feedback.
We have made some changes to the playtest build. Let us know what you think!

- Left click is now used for a "Single Heal" that heals only one party member.
- Right click can now be unlocked to cast a "Multi Heal" that heals multiple nearby friends. Indicated by white borders.
- Removed a lot of the UI around the mouse pointer, giving you a clearer view in the fray.
- Borders now flash red when targeted by shooting enemies.
- Friends no longer drop coins on death.
- Enemy spoils are pushed from the center.
- Removed the radius upgrade.
- Max mana upgrade split into a lower level and a higher level one.
- Added a Leaderboard viewer. There is one board for each of the levels. How did _you_ do?
- Various balancing changes and tweaks.
- General UI fixes.
- Quit button: Yaaay!
- Cleanup of title screen
- Cleanup of the top navigation
- You can now drag to swap two units in the warband section

Whats next?
We are hard at work polishing this up for a next fest demo.
Leave your feedback in the community section right here on steam. We read everything!

Thank you!
Let's go!

/Hannes & Alfred
